question: In March 2025, what ranking did Deepti Sharma achieve in the ICC Women's all rounders rankings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Deepti Sharma achieved the **5th rank** in the ICC Women's All-rounders Rankings in March 2025.
 
• Deepti Sharma is one of India's most prominent all-rounders, excelling in both batting and bowling in international cricket.
 
• The ICC Rankings consider a player's performance across all formats (ODIs, T20Is, and Tests) to determine their ranking.
 
• Deepti's consistent performances in international tournaments contributed significantly to her rise in the rankings.
 
• The ICC updates its rankings regularly based on players' performances in recent matches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ICC Women’s Rankings:**

 
 
• These rankings evaluate players’ performances in batting, bowling, and all-rounder categories across all formats of cricket.
 
• Points are calculated using a sophisticated algorithm that takes into account match context, opponent strength, and individual contributions.
 
 
 
• **Deepti Sharma’s Cricketing Achievements:**
 
 
• She has been a key player for the Indian Women’s Cricket Team, known for her dependable off-spin and strong batting performances.
 
• She holds the record for the highest individual score in Women's ODIs for India (188* against Ireland in 2017).
 
 
 
• **All-rounder Role in Cricket:**
 
 
• An all-rounder contributes significantly to both batting and bowling, making them a valuable asset to any team.
 
• Notable women’s cricket all-rounders include Ellyse Perry (Australia), Sophie Devine (New Zealand), and Stafanie Taylor (West Indies).
 
 
 
• **ICC's Role in Cricket:**
 
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) is the global governing body for cricket.
 
• It oversees international competitions, rankings, and the development of the sport worldwide.
